    Did Elon Musk attend Queen's university?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Elon Musk attended Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, Canada, from 1990 to 1992. He spent his first two years of university there before transferring to the University of Pennsylvania on a scholarship. During his time at Queen's, he studied business and met his first wife, Justine Wilson.

      Description

      Queens College is a public college in the New York City borough of Queens. Part of the City University of New York system, Queens College occupies an 83-acre campus primarily located in Flushing. Wikipedia
      Address: 65-30 Kissena Blvd, Flushing, NY 11367

      Undergraduate tuition and fees: In-state tuition 7,538 USD, Out-of-state tuition 15,488 USD (2023 – 24) IPEDS

      Founded: 1937
      Phone: (718) 997-5000
